rationale: Centering the issuance rank genuinely changes the economics of the product (the short leg becomes illiquid heavy diluters versus illiquid non-diluters rather than distressed versus non-distressed), making this a decisive diagnostic rather than a cosmetic rewrap of the archived serial-dilution signal — though note it purges only the moderator's main effect, leaving the issuance main effect at half weight, so a surviving alpha is not yet proof of a pure interaction.

target_name: Serial dilution inside the working-capital-deficit group
rationale: The indicator assigns zero to every positive-working-capital firm, and since RANK lies in [0,1] that zero mass sits at the bottom of the cross-section, so the long-short sort actually contrasts the untreated majority against WC-deficit diluters — the opposite of the clean within-group test claimed, and the massive tie block will also distort the Fama-MacBeth slope.

Scaling cumulative issuance by the pre-raise asset base is an economically motivated denominator-endogeneity fix that can materially reorder the heaviest diluters while holding the moderator fixed for clean attribution; the only caveats are reduced coverage from the three-year lag requirement and extreme ratios for tiny firms, which the rank transform should largely absorb.

target_name: Serial dilution with an accumulated earnings deficit
rationale: A legitimate moderator-substitution robustness test with a slow-moving, low-turnover conditioning variable, but RE/AT is a heavily mined distress/quality proxy and its product with cumulative issuance sits close to the known composite external-financing and net-share-issuance anomalies, so a positive result will be hard to distinguish from rediscovery.

The centered-repurchase construction does contrast illiquid buyers-back against illiquid non-buyers-back rather than simply reproducing the buyback/payout-yield anomaly, and long-side evidence is genuinely missing from this archive, but the intersection of heavy sustained repurchases and severe illiquidity is economically rare, so expect thin, unstable extreme portfolios.

target_name: Magnitude and habituality of dilution combined
rationale: This is an ensemble average of two highly correlated legs of the same archived signal with the identical moderator and no new mechanism — by the proposer's own admission a "measurement-efficiency consolidation" — so it is a cosmetic variant whose expected gain is noise reduction on already-known results rather than new economic information.
